scoring_justification: The main claim is a structural property (asymptotic convergence and a 10% bound); no hidden gold values are required.

outputs.description: Relative phase retardance Δ as a function of grating period/wavelength ratio (a/λ) and conductor width/period ratio (d/a). The checker will verify monotonic convergence to -π/2 as a/λ decreases and that |Δ + π/2| ≤ 0.15·(π/2) for all a/λ ≤ 0.5.

output_contract.notes: Structural audit verifies the asymptotic behaviour and the 10% bound without recomputing the underlying transmission coefficients.

steps.description: Group CSV by d_a and verify: (1) for each group, Δ at the smallest a_lambda (≈0.001) is within 0.05 rad of -π/2; (2) for all rows with a_lambda ≤ 0.5, |Δ + π/2| ≤ 0.15·(π/2). Fraction of groups passing both yields the score.
